title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Fragmentation using Diagenode Megaruptor®3
author: Maja Todorovic

steps.title: Prepare and Label Tubes
steps.instruction: Label the required number of Diagenode Hydro Tubes for each DNA sample on both the lid and the side.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA samples for transfer to the shearing tubes.

substeps.instruction: Mix the DNA sample by pipetting carefully with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Transfer between 100 µL and 500 µL of each DNA sample to the corresponding labeled Diagenode Hydro Tube.

steps.title: Normalize Sample Volumes
steps.instruction: Ensure all tubes have an equal volume using EB buffer or nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Seal and Centrifuge Tubes
steps.instruction: Replace the Hydro Tube lids and briefly centrifuge the tubes using a mini-centrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Hydropore-Syringes
steps.instruction: Verify the integrity of the Hydropore-Syringes before attachment.

substeps.instruction: Check that each syringe is screwed together.
Ensure all joints/screw tops are tight.
Ensure the plunger is pushed all the way down.

steps.title: Attach Syringes to Tubes
steps.instruction: Remove the Hydro Tube lids and firmly push a Hydropore-Syringe onto the top of the tube (do not screw on). Retain the lid.

steps.title: Initialize Megaruptor®3
steps.instruction: Switch on the Diagenode Megaruptor®3 and initialize using the on-screen instructions.

substeps.instruction: Remove the loading cassette by lifting it up and away from the base unit.
Wait approximately 3 seconds for the arms to set to the 'zero' position.
Replace the cassette on the base unit.

steps.title: Configure Run Parameters
steps.instruction: Use the touch screen to select 'Protocols' and then 'Go & Shear', setting the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Concentration: Select the highest concentration in the sample set (Note: samples in a run should not vary by more than ± 25 ng/µL; samples < 50 ng/µL should not be combined with those above; samples > 150 ng/µL must be diluted).

steps.title: Load Samples into Cassette
steps.instruction: Load the Hydropore-Syringes into the cassette when prompted by the touch screen.

substeps.instruction: Balance the load symmetrically across the 8 positions, using empty balance Hydropore-Syringes for uneven sample numbers.
Orientate the Hydropore-Syringe so the clear side faces out to allow observation of the DNA solution.

steps.title: Execute and Monitor Shearing
steps.instruction: Start the program and visually confirm that all syringes are drawing up liquid.

substeps.instruction: Verify liquid movement once the 'shearing' step is reached.
Allow the run to proceed (approximately 45 mins; note that the machine countdown is not accurate).

steps.title: Recover Sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Remove the Hydropore-Syringes from the instrument and the Hydro Tubes.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Hydropore-Syringe from the Hydro Tube while pressing down on the plunger to collect residual liquid/sample from the hydropore.

steps.title: Cleanup and Storage
steps.instruction: Finalize the process and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Discard the Hydropore-Syringes as biological waste.
Replace the retained lids onto the Hydro Tubes.
Store the sheared DNA at 4 °C until further processing.
